featured_reviews.review_text: Nice Shop. Genuine products.  Staff is very helpful. Ambiance is good. Just bought a laptop and a phone.

featured_reviews.name: Aarti Javeri
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently made a purchase from Croma, and the experience was truly exceptional—far exceeding my expectations. We were exploring options about which laptop to buy (Mac vs Windows) and the sales personnel there (Sam) was extremely helpful. Instead of just mentioning the specs, he actually took the time to understand my needs. He showed us several options and allowed me to take time to assess multiple devices on display. The sales team was very transparent with regards to all the discounts available as well. We decided on a laptop which wasn’t available in store and it was arranged for me within 2 days! I was very pleased with the service . Not just that, upon receiving the laptop I wanted to just make sure the basic functions were okay and I spend almost 45 mins verifying them, during the process I was not only offered a chair , but even water and the sales personnel (Sam) made sure I was satisfied with my purchase within the store itself. Very highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: K Shashidhar
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the worst after sale service. I purchased fridge, TV, Washing machine and Hob, with a cost of Rs.86000/-. Once sold no installation support. Buyers should be extra careful, whatever service required, it should be availed upfront before making full payment, otherwise it will be nightmare even for installation.

featured_reviews.name: DrSantosh P
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hidden Charges and Misleading Information – Pathetic Post-Purchase Service!
​Highly disappointed with Croma Sion. Before buying, you are told one thing, and post-purchase, the story completely changes.
​I recently purchased an AC from this store. While the company/brand clearly states that there are no installation charges, the store management and delivery team are now demanding extra "Handling Charges" and "Installation Charges."
​Taking full payment first and then surprising customers with hidden, unauthorized fees is a terrible business practice. This completely ruins the trust we place in a Tata enterprise. Total lack of transparency and pathetic customer care. Be very careful before billing anything here!

featured_reviews.name: Parasnath Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have Visited croma Sion on 1st May, met 2 dynamic executive Danis Khan and Faizan Khan.

They gave me best deal for the day on Voltas AC.

Danish has good product knowledge and Faizan gave end to end product specification and offers related information.

But the most important thing is after sales service which I experienced from Faizan Khan was fabulous.

There was some error related to some information feeding in system and which was noticed by Faizan and closed by him by end to end follow up.

These both guys are very good at their individual capacity and these should should be motivated further.

Thank you Croma Sion, Thank you , Faizan and Danish for the services provided.

Last experience, 2 years back when I purchased  same voltas ac from croma and pathetic.

Hope in future we will experience same experience as we got on 1st May in coming future.

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Chakote
featured_reviews.review_text: Very disappointed with the service from Chroma. We ordered an AC and after several days of delay, we were informed that the product was not even available. Now that the AC is finally available, the installation is again getting delayed without any proper communication or support. Such poor coordination and customer service, especially during summer, is unacceptable. Customers expect timely delivery and installation after making full payment. Highly dissatisfied with the overall experience.

Excellent Service by Nandini at Reliance, Phoenix Marketcity Kurla

I had a wonderful shopping experience at Reliance, Phoenix Marketcity Kurla, thanks to Nandini. She is extremely polite, professional, and very knowledgeable about the products. She patiently understood my requirements, guided me with the best options, and made the entire process smooth and stress-free.

featured_reviews.name: Aditi Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely pathetic experience with Reliance Digital, Kurla and their RESQ service team. This has been one of the most mentally exhausting customer service experiences I have ever dealt with.

Sunil Sahu and his entire team have repeatedly promised AC installation “within 24 hours of delivery,” yet there has been absolutely no accountability, no coordination, and no actual installation done. What is worse is the complete lack of transparency and professionalism.

I must have called the store at least 50 times just to get a simple answer on whether the installation would happen today or tomorrow. Every single time, a new baseless deadline was given with zero follow-through. Nobody seems to know anything, nobody calls back, and nobody takes ownership. Customers are simply left waiting endlessly after making full payment.

The amount of mental harassment and inconvenience caused because of this incompetence is unbelievable — especially in Mumbai heat where an AC is not a luxury but a necessity. Selling products is easy, but Reliance Digital completely fails when it comes to post-sales service.

And please DO NOT waste your money on the Reliance RESQ plan. It is honestly one of the worst services I have ever seen. They happily take your money but disappear when actual service is needed.

If you value your time, peace of mind, and basic customer respect, avoid Reliance Digital, Phoenix Market City, Kurla and RESQ services completely.

featured_reviews.review_text: Had a fantastic experience at Croma thanks to the Ghulam Mohammad. featured_reviews.name: Pranit Kamble
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1/5 – Absolutely Pathetic Service | Waste of Time

I visited the Croma store at Phoenix Marketcity, Kurla West to buy a smartphone on EMI, and it turned out to be one of the worst retail experiences I’ve ever had.

It took nearly 3 hours to purchase a single phone—purely because of the staff’s carelessness and incompetence. The EMI process alone wasted 45+ minutes due to their silly internal mistakes. After that, the salesperson gave a wrong IMEI number to the loan processor—an IMEI that was already sold and completely unacceptable. This blunder caused yet another long delay.

As if that wasn’t enough, the salesperson then went outside the store to arrange another phone, which took almost an hour more. Throughout this entire ordeal, the staff’s attitude was extremely casual, irresponsible, and arrogant, repeatedly telling us to “wait another 30 minutes” even after we had already waited over 2 hours.

There was zero respect for the customer’s time, no accountability, and no urgency. This is exactly the reason why the majority of people prefer shopping online—at least online platforms value time and provide smoother processes.

I will never suggest anyone to buy anything from this store. If you value your time and sanity, stay away.

featured_reviews.name: Jenny of all Trades
featured_reviews.review_text:
The most pathetic and disgusting after-sales service we have ever experienced.

We purchased an AC from Croma and paid in full by cash. When the compressor stopped working, absolutely nobody was willing to help us. Mumbai temperatures were touching 43°C, and despite repeatedly informing the staff that we have 3-year-old twins at home and my mother had recently undergone surgery, our complaint was treated with complete insensitivity.

For 3 continuous days, we were made to wait while being fed false promises like, “We are arranging a technician for you today itself, madam.” Yet nothing was actually done. Managers, supervisors, customer care agents — nobody took responsibility or offered any real assistance. Every single call involved repeating the same details over and over again, with zero action taken.

To make matters worse, after the third day, they literally switched off their phones and became unreachable.

Such inhuman, irresponsible, and pathetic after-sales service is unacceptable from a company like Croma. A brand that cannot stand by its customers during genuine emergencies does not deserve customer trust or loyalty.

featured_reviews.review_text:
To,
The Consumer Court Authority
Subject: Complaint regarding poor service and rude behavior from Croma service staff
Respected Sir/Madam,
I would like to file a complaint regarding the poor service and unprofessional behavior related to my air conditioner purchased from Croma. We bought a Panasonic AC with a 1-year company warranty and an additional 4-year extended warranty from Croma.
Within just one year, the AC stopped working properly. We contacted the service center and reported the problem. After that, a technician came to check the AC and wrongly said that the AC was very old. We then showed him the purchase bill which clearly proves that the AC is only one year old.
Later another technician came and checked the AC. Just before Holi, they took the AC part for repair and returned it after about one week. However, when we tried to contact the technician for updates, he spoke very rudely.
Recently, when we called again, the technician spoke very disrespectfully with the ladies in our house. He used rude words and said things like “You keep the phone, I will see later, have patience,” in a very improper manner. This behavior is completely unacceptable.
It is surprising that a reputed company like Croma hires staff who do not know how to speak respectfully with customers. We expect proper service and respectful communication, especially after purchasing extended warranty.
Therefore, I request the Consumer Court to please take strict action regarding this issue and ensure that proper service is provided to us. This kind of behavior and service is very disappointing.
Thank you.
